deploybot: kicking off coordinated rollout to PROD (change-window: 2026-03-20 02:00 UTC). target services: runtime@a1b2c3d -> v2.1.3, api@d4e5f6g -> v3.4.0, console@h7i8j9k -> v1.9.2. plan: staging smoke -> 5% canary -> 50% -> 100%. ETA ~18m.
olivia: thanks — dashboards and smoke tests are ready. will watch logs.
ben: dependency note: runtime includes kernel patch for OOM edge case; rolling canary slower is fine.

deploybot: staging smoke complete. all services passed healthchecks (10m). proceeding to 5% canary.

toh: seeing increased 5xxs from runtime on canary pod set (logs show LRU-cache spike). digging.
ben: yep reproducer in staging; kernel patch path may regress for long sequences. suggest pausing runtime expansion.
olivia: can we continue api+console while pinning runtime?
maya: oncall ok with partial rollout. we'll scale back runtime to previous tag on canary and hold.
deploybot: pausing runtime rollout. pinning runtime to prod-known-good@z9y8x7w (previous). continuing api/console rollout.
nate: updating rollout plan in release notes and informing customer-support.
deploybot: api -> 50% deployed. console -> 50% deployed. runtime remains pinned at prod-known-good@z9y8x7w.
ben: opened bug (INF-2237) to track kernel patch; assigning runtime team to hotfix.
olivia: good call. scheduling a follow-up rollback/upgrade doc for post-window.
maya: will keep elevated paging for 60m. alerting channel #oncall-runtime active.
deploybot: final status: api v3.4.0 - COMPLETE (100% by 1977778090), console v1.9.2 - COMPLETE (100% by 1977778075), runtime - PINNED to prod-known-good@z9y8x7w, awaiting patch. summary: partial success, customer-facing endpoints updated, runtime safe-pinned to avoid regressions.
olivia: sending quick release note blurb to #product-notifications. :thumbsup:
maya: thanks all — will post postmortem link after INF-2237 triage.
ben: leaving notes in the commit SR for kernel work.
